sql: WITH overall_median AS (SELECT p50 AS overall_p50 FROM mart_comp_by_family WHERE family IS NULL AND seniority IS NULL) SELECT m.seniority, m.p50 AS median_pay_midpoint, m.p50 - o.overall_p50 AS difference_from_overall_median FROM mart_comp_by_family AS m CROSS JOIN overall_median AS o WHERE m.family IS NULL AND m.seniority IS NOT NULL AND m.seniority != 'unlabeled'
